title.en: Healthy pets and small animal supplies

text.en: Shoppers appreciate the store's wide selection of products catering to dogs, cats, guinea pigs, and hamsters. Multiple reviewers praise the welfare and presentation of small pets available for adoption or sale. Pet owners also note that the branch provides sensitive support during difficult times, such as arranging pet cremation arrangements.

Customers frequently commend the Drumchapel store at Great Western Retail Park for its tidy aisles and comprehensive stock. Reviewers mention that finding specialized pet food, health supplements, and daily pet accessories is straightforward. Shoppers value having a spacious, easily navigable retail location with ample parking in the retail park.

title.en: Helpful team with occasional customer friction

text.en: The majority of reviewers highlight the friendly and knowledgeable assistance provided by store employees, noting that staff enjoy discussing pet welfare and giving helpful product advice. However, one customer reported an unwelcome encounter when inquiring about rabbit adoption, feeling lectured by an employee. Most shoppers nevertheless report pleasant customer service.

q.en: Where is the Drumchapel store located?

a.en: The store is situated within the Great Western Retail Park in Drumchapel, offering convenient parking.

q.en: Are small animals like guinea pigs and hamsters available?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention a good selection of healthy small pets, including guinea pigs and hamsters.

q.en: Does the store assist with end-of-life pet arrangements?

a.en: Yes, clients report that the branch provides compassionate support when arranging pet cremation services.

q.en: What range of pet products is kept in stock?

a.en: Shoppers report extensive ranges of pet foods, healthcare supplies, and everyday pet accessories for dogs, cats, and small animals.
